name: bux
description: Run your own bux (Browser Use Box) on ORB Cloud — a 24/7 Claude Code agent with a real browser, texted via Telegram. Browser runs on Browser Use Cloud (off-box) so CRIU can checkpoint your agent cleanly. v0 is pinned in RAM (sleep = "never"); v0.5 swaps Telegram polling for webhook mode to realize ORB's $0-idle savings story.

required_secrets.name: BROWSER_USE_API_KEY
required_secrets.purpose: Browser Use Cloud key. Free tier gives 3 concurrent browsers + proxies + CAPTCHA solving. browser_keeper.py uses it to maintain a long-lived browser session bound to a fresh per-deploy profile.

optional_inputs.name: BUX_PROFILE_ID
optional_inputs.purpose: Reuse an existing BU Cloud profile (cookies, logins, cache). Leave unset for a fresh profile per deploy — usually what you want.

optional_inputs.name: DEPLOY_NAME
optional_inputs.purpose: Identifier for this deploy. Used in DELETE /v1/swarms/<id> for teardown.

post_deploy_steps: Run `sudo -iu bux && claude /login` to authenticate Claude Code (Anthropic API key OR Claude Max OAuth)
Run `bux-setup-tg` (interactive wizard) to create + register a Telegram bot via @BotFather and bind your chat — the supervisor in start.sh picks up the new config within 5 seconds
phase_0_5_planned: Telegram webhook mode (replaces long-poll, enables sleep = "auto")
browser_keeper.py passive-sleep loop (epoll/select instead of clock_nanosleep)
ORB_COMPUTER_ID env var injection so start.sh can call setWebhook against its own subdomain
